author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing treats a page below the first as the first page
summary: Asking the owner listing for a page below the first currently shows the error page. The listing must instead read any such page as the first page and return the ordinary listing.
acceptance_criteria: given owners to list, when the listing is asked for with a page below the first, then the first page of matches is listed
given owners to list, when the listing is asked for with a page below the first, then no error page is shown
given a search naming a last name, when the listing is asked for with a page below the first, then the first page of that search's matches is listed
given an empty search, when the listing is asked for with a page below the first, then the first page of every owner is listed
non_goals: a page value that is not a number
a page value past the last page
notes: Intake recorded the bug report only; no further owner decisions (handoff.jsonl line 1). Scope is bounded to page values below the first, quoted as 'any page value below 1'. The uncovered cases are recorded as open questions in docs/prd.md rather than defaulted. No Non-Goals row changed, so no scope_overrides.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Existing pattern, one small adjustment. The cause is in OwnerController.findPaginatedForOwnersLastName: PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) receives a negative index for any page below 1 and Spring Data rejects it, so the request ends on the error page. Normalizing the requested page is request binding, not a business rule, so the architecture-principles Web controller row is satisfied and no new controller-rule deviation is created. It also places range normalization at the external-input boundary, which is where security-principles Trust Boundaries puts it. Normalize once at the top of processFindForm (Math.max(page, 1)) and pass the normalized value to BOTH findPaginatedForOwnersLastName and addPaginationModel; clamping inside the query helper alone would leave currentPage at 0 in the model, and templates/owners/ownersList.html does link arithmetic on currentPage. system-design.md is updated: the OwnerController Contracts row now lists REQ-OWNERSPAGEPARAM-001, and the Contracts invariant paragraph records the read-below-first-as-first behavior. No ADR: no trade-off and nothing hard to reverse.
integration_points: OwnerController.processFindForm — the single normalization point for the page request parameter
OwnerController.addPaginationModel — receives the normalized page so the model's currentPage is never below 1
OwnerRepository.findByLastNameStartingWith — unchanged; it receives a Pageable whose page index is never negative

patterns.description: @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") int page — the existing one-based page parameter convention; the fix keeps it one-based and does not change the parameter contract

existing MockMvc listing test shape (stub findByLastNameStartingWith with a multi-element Page, assert status and view name) — the three new tests follow it, adding an assertion that the model's currentPage is 1

risks.risk: The listing branch is only reached when more than one owner matches; a single match redirects and an empty result re-renders the search form. A test stubbing a one-element page would assert the wrong branch.
risks.mitigation: Stub a Page with more than one owner in all three new tests, as the existing multi-owner listing tests do.

risks.risk: VetController.findPaginated carries the identical page - 1 defect. The PRD lists the veterinarian directory as a non-goal for this slice.
risks.mitigation: Do not touch VetController. The divergence is now recorded in system-design.md's Contracts invariant paragraph so a later slice can pick it up.

risks.risk: Over-reach into the two open PRD questions — a non-numeric page value and a page past the last page.
risks.mitigation: Both are declared non-goals. A non-numeric value still yields the framework's binding failure; leave that path unchanged.

notes: Five-signal foundational check: none tripped. system-design.md is populated and partly confirmed, ADRs record the language/framework and the architecture shape, ubiquitous-language.md is written and confirmed, request-parameter handling in a web controller has a recorded pattern, and the slice introduces no new bounded context. No design-doc-autofix records exist in the log, so the autofix audit is empty. Coverage claim basis: direct read of OwnerController.java and ownersList.html (the IDE oracle is not connected in this run; a read of the whole file is the stronger basis here since the file is small). Process note: this dispatch read the prd-entry and durable memory before appending its dispatch-start record, so the dispatch-start sits at line 4 rather than being the first tool call.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owners-listing page parameter to the first page

blast_radius.note: Seven production lines in one method of OwnerController, one module, no sensitive paths; the other three files are two docs edits and the test file, and the 14 hunks are mostly prose.

semantic_surprise.note: Math.max(page, 1) is computed once at the top of processFindForm and both former uses of the raw parameter are switched to it, so nothing reads the unclamped value; pages of 1 or above are unaffected and the only behavior change is that a below-first page renders the listing instead of throwing out of PageRequest.of.

test_adequacy.note: The three new MockMvc tests assert two independent observable outcomes, the model's currentPage and, via an ArgumentCaptor, the page index actually handed to the repository, and each would have failed against the pre-fix code, so they are not restatements of the implementation; they cover zero, negative, and the named-last-name branch.
